tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search public Jobsai job listings.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Get a public Jobsai job detail by id or slug.

tools.name: submit_application
tools.description: Submit an application on behalf of the candidate represented by the consent envelope.

tools.name: get_application_status
tools.description: Read an application status for the consent-envelope candidate.

tools.name: list_applications
tools.description: List all applications for the consent-envelope candidate.

tools.name: subscribe
tools.description: Subscribe to application status change notifications for the consent-envelope candidate.

tools.name: stream_matches
tools.description: Stream new job-match events for an agent client.

tools.name: withdraw_application
tools.description: Withdraw an application on behalf of the consent-envelope candidate.

tools.name: saved_jobs
tools.description: List, save, or unsave the consent-envelope candidate's bookmarked jobs.

tools.name: propose_action
tools.description: Propose one concrete candidate action (application, job question, interview decision, requirements update) for the candidate's own confirmation. Nothing runs until the candidate confirms.

tools.name: get_action_proposal
tools.description: Read the candidate's decision on a proposal: status, the final command including the candidate's edits, and the one-shot approval window.

tools.name: execute_approved_action
tools.description: Execute exactly the command the candidate confirmed, once, while the approval is valid.

tools.name: list_employer_jobs
tools.description: List the represented company's own job postings (drafts included) with status and public visibility window. Needs a representation envelope.

tools.name: get_employer_job
tools.description: Get one of the represented company's job postings for editing: full text, salary, verified conditions with revision, editHash and visibility.

tools.name: list_employer_branches
tools.description: List the represented company's workplaces (branches) for the job conditions workplace field.

tools.name: create_job_draft
tools.description: Create a draft job posting for the represented company. Nothing is public until publish_job.

tools.name: update_job
tools.description: Edit a job posting of the represented company (optimistic lock by editHash). Editing an active job is public at once and needs employer_jobs:publish. Changing the title or description raises terms.revision and unconfirms all verified conditions; call get_employer_job again before update_job_terms or

tools.name: update_job_terms
tools.description: Set the verified conditions of a job (salary basis, bonuses, shifts, start, training, remote mode, workplace). A stale terms.revision returns facts_changed with reason stale_terms_revision: read the job again.

tools.name: confirm_job_terms
tools.description: Confirm listed job conditions as stated by the company (renews their evidence).

tools.name: publish_job
tools.description: Publish a draft or archived job of the represented company. The company must be verified and the job must have a salary range.

tools.name: archive_job
tools.description: Archive (unpublish) a job posting of the represented company.

tools.name: confirm_job_open
tools.description: Confirm the job is still open: it stays publicly visible for 60 days from now.
